workflow.because: ADR-0056 D5 names the files of .github/workflows/. Any file added there counts, a workflow GitHub would not run included: the negative says the pull request adds nothing to that directory, and a narrower reading would let a file that becomes a workflow by a later rename pass.

schema.because: Measured on 2026-10-23 over the served branch of the 22 unarchived libre-ai repositories: 320 tracked paths end in .schema.json, every file under a schemas/ directory among them; the 13 other paths containing 'schema' are code (validators, tests, a Rust module), a migration snapshot and a vendored third-party .proto. Rerun: for each repository, `gh api repos/libre-ai/<repo>/git/trees/<served branch>?recursive=1 --jq '.tree[] | select(.type=="blob") | .path' | grep -i schema | grep -v fixture`.

dependency.because: Manifests are matched by file name, at any depth. A section path is dotted; `*` matches any one key (a Cargo target cfg). The two read formats cover the manifests tracked by this repository except tools/licensing/requirements.txt; a manifest matching unreadManifestPatterns is named and makes a declared `dependency` negative unverifiable, never a silent zero.
